teaser: Take a breakfast detour from bread to a material fit for a sturdy belt.
reasons: Bread becomes toast when browned with heat.
Toast is often spread with butter.
Butter is made by churning cream.
Cream comes from a cow's milk.
A cow's hide can be made into leather.
clues: This breakfast food is bread browned with heat.
A yellow spread often put on this breakfast food.
The rich part of milk churned to make this spread.
The farm animal whose milk provides this.
A tough material made by tanning this animal's hide.
